schema.title: Axiacracy - State Value System (full VSS)
schema.description: Comprehensive value-flow map of a value-flow-governed state, generated from the empirical survey: 11 citizen cohorts, households, 3 business types, the commons, 17 executive ministries, 3 guardians, legislative/judicial, municipalities, and other parties (NGOs/academia/religion/media/unions/finance/central bank), with the external boundary (resources/trade/polities/diaspora/FDI). Flows carry value and anti-value elements. Magnitudes are placeholder (unit 'rel') pending quantification. Node 'link' can point each ministry to its own sub-VSS.
schema.author: Victor Bolshakov / Orkestron.AI

texts.text: blue=internal value - red=anti-value - green=external in - gold=external out - purple=control (weights/rules)
